newsitem.title: USA: Rouge Steel organizes as holding company.
newsitem.headline: Rouge Steel organizes as holding company.

text.p: Rouge Steel Co said Thursday it has organized as a holding company to reflect expansion of its business beyond its core steel making operations.
Under the new structure, Rouge Steel Co became a wholly-owned subsidiary of Rouge Industries Inc.

"The restructuring is symbolic of the emerging growth of our company's value-added businesses which we consider an important adjunct to improving the product offerings and cost performance of our core steel making business," said Carl Valdiserri, chairman and chief executive officer of Rouge Industries Inc.

"The new structure will permit us to expand our ancillary value-added businesses and pursue new opportunities while protecting our investments in improving the products and cost structure of Rouge Steel Company, our core steel making business," he said in a news release.
Each holder of Rouge Steel Co class A common stock will receive the same number of shares of Rouge Industries Inc class A common stock on a share-for-share basis.

Rouge Industries Inc will hold the outstanding stock of Rouge Steel Co, QS Steel Inc, and Eveleth Taconite Co. QS Steel, a Michigan corporation, holds minority equity positions in three Michigan-based joint venture companies: Shiloh of Michigan L.L.C., Spartan Steel Coating L.L.C. and TWB Co L.L.C.. Eveleth Taconite holds the company's 45 percent interest in Eveleth Mines LLC, a Minnesota-based iron ore mining and pellet producing operation.
Rouge Steel Company is an integrated flat rolled sheet steel producer with its manufacturing facilities and corporate offices located in Dearborn, Michigan.
